name: comp_id
description: compositions.comp_id of the comp this is a variant of, for the same patch

name: variant_id
description: Hash of the comp id and the units and traits the variant adds or drops; stays the same across reruns while those do

name: label
description: The comp's label plus its main differences, e.g. 'Executioner Draven +Kennen -Sett'

name: boards
description: Boards in the patch assigned to this variant

name: matches
description: Distinct matches with at least one such board

name: units
description: Units on at least 25% of the variant's boards, most common first

fields.name: frequency
fields.description: Share of the variant's boards that had the unit (0-1)

fields.name: avg_items
fields.description: Items held, averaged over the boards that had the unit

fields.name: avg_star
fields.description: Star level, averaged over the boards that had the unit

name: traits
description: Active traits on at least 25% of the variant's boards, most common first

fields.name: frequency
fields.description: Share of the variant's boards where the trait was active (0-1)

fields.name: avg_tier
fields.description: tier_current, averaged over the boards where it was active

name: diff
description: What sets the variant apart from its comp: units and traits whose frequency differs by 30 points or more, biggest first

fields.name: change
fields.description: added (more common in the variant) or removed (less common)

fields.name: frequency
fields.description: Share of the variant's boards that had it (0-1)

fields.name: family_frequency
fields.description: Share of all the comp's boards that had it (0-1)
